cheats.name: (Tap L Twice) To Skip Intro
cheats.note: On game start up, as soon as you see the N64 Logo, Tap the L Button twice letting go eachtime.

cheats.name: Start with Infinite  9  Granades or Bombs
cheats.note: This works for all Players, including player 1 in story mode.
